description:
Cast Broodguard Elite for its warp cost by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Broodguard Elite, adding {G}.
When Broodguard Elite dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Broodguard Elite trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Broodguard Elite from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
